technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish (ADX strong, EMA/SMA aligned) but short-term momentum is weak with price below key moving averages, no crossover signals, and bearish MACD—confluence insufficient for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CMS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 7 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (23/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (434+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (421.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent earnings create a highly adverse macro backdrop with elevated binary event risk for CMS.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure is bullish (ADX strong, EMA 50/200 aligned) with price near support (61.421) in extreme fear zone offering contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Imminent earnings (7 days), crisis VIX, bearish short-term momentum (MACD negative, price below EMA 9/21, no crossovers), weak fundamentals (zero insider/institutional support), and unfavorable macro environment create unacceptable binary risk that outweighs long-term bullish structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term trend structure remains bullish with strong ADX and EMA alignment, and price is positioned at support in an extreme fear zone. However, imminent earnings (7 days), crisis VIX, and bearish short-term momentum create unacceptable binary risk that negates the structural opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 7 days combined with crisis-level VIX (421.6) and bearish MACD momentum creates high probability of gap move that could invalidate support and trigger stop-loss.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk; bear case dominates despite bullish structure
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 141 positions in Utilities sector with existing CMS position; adding concentration in unfavorable macro environment with imminent earnings is imprudent risk management.
